title: Entity Recycle Bin
description: This mod stores dead entity data in the Windows Recycle Bin.
body:
This mod enables all entities to save their full entity data to the Windows Recycle Bin upon death. You can use the native restore feature of the Windows Recycle Bin to one-click resurrect the corresponding deceased entities (Windows only at this time).

It offers players a super simple way to reverse irreversible consequences caused by in-game misoperations.
